title.narrative: Kosovo Social Assistance System Reform Project

description.narrative: The development objective of the Social Assistance System Reform Project for Kosovo is to improve the equity and adaptability of Kosovos social safety net. The project comprises of three components. The first component, strengthening social protection delivery systems will include: a) a set of investments in core delivery systems, which will improve the equity and adaptability of the social assistance scheme SAS) and the social protection system more broadly, and b) resources to support the governments aim of promoting the activation of SAS beneficiaries into the active labor market, to improve equity in access to complementary services for SAS beneficiaries. It consists of following sub-components: i) strengthen the social protection delivery systems; and ii) supporting the activation of SAS beneficiaries. The second component, improving the performance of the SAS consists of following sub-components: i) responding to Coronavirus disease 2019 COVID-19) through SAS; ii) supporting the introduction of the new eligibility criteria for the SAS; and iii) implementation of the proposed SAS legislation. The third component, project implementation and management aim to strengthen the capacity of the Ministry of Finance, Labor, and Transfers MFLT) to manage the SAS and meet the World Bank financial management FM), procurement, and environmental and social framework ESF) requirements.
The objective of the project is to improve the equity and adaptability of Kosovo's social safety net.

condition.narrative: Schedule 2, Section 1.B.4: For purposes of carrying out and prior to commencing the implementation of the activities under Part 2.Cof the Project, the Recipient, through MFLT, shall adopt the Cash Transfers Manual for SAS Beneficiaries to include the RevisedEligibility Criteria for SAS Beneficiaries acceptable to the Association.

Schedule 2, Section I.A.3: The Recipient, through the MFLT, shall: (a) no later than sixty (60) days after the Effective Date, orat a later date as agreed with the Association, establish a PCU within MFLT, with the following staff: a project coordinator, aninformation technology expert to coordinate Part 1.A of the Project, a financial management expert, a procurement expert and asocial expert all with terms of reference satisfactory to the Association; (b) thereafter maintain throughout the implementation ofthe Project, this PCU with such composition, functions, staffing and resources satisfactory to the Association; and (c) vest theresponsibility for day-to-day coordination of the implementation of Project activities in the PCU.

Schedule 2, Section I.B.1: Unless otherwise agreed between the Association and the Recipient, the Recipient shall, no later thansixty (60) days after the Effective Date prepare and adopt, through MFLT and DSPF, a manual containing detailed guidelines andprocedures for the implementation of the Project, including: (i) for Parts 1 and 2.A of the Project, the Current SAS EligibilityCriteria for the selection of said beneficiaries in accordance with the relevant Recipient's legislation; (ii) administration andcoordination, monitoring and evaluation, financial management, procurement and accounting procedures, environmental and socialsafeguards, anti-corruption and fraud mitigation measures, a grievance redress mechanism; (iii) provisions on Personal Datacollection and processing in accordance with international standards and good international practice; (iv) roles andresponsibilities for Project implementation, including the specific roles and responsibilities of the agencies and units involvedin Project implementation; and (v) such other arrangements and procedures as shall be required for the effective implementation ofthe Project, in form and substance satisfactory to the Association (“Project Operations Manual”).

Schedule 2, Section I.B.2: For purposes of carrying out activities under Part 1.B of the Project, the Recipient shall prepare andadopt prior to commencing the implementation of the activities under Part 1.B, the Activation Manual providing for, inter alia,outreach and communication regarding the activation procedures, profiling and referral of SAS Beneficiaries and QualifyingHouseholds to suitable services and programs, Training, and provision of incentives for activation, implementation arrangements,monitoring and evaluation.

Schedule 2, Section I.B.3: For purposes of carrying out and prior to commencing the implementation of the activities under Part 2.Bof the Project, the Recipient, through MFLT, shall adopt the Cash Transfers Manual for Qualifying Households to include theEligibility Criteria for Qualifying Households acceptable to the Association and in accordance with the Concept Document.

actual.value: The draft of the main SAS legislation includes a temporary assistance program meant to respond to shocks and the final version will include also the possibility of SAS program to expand coverage in response to shocks.
